To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
technology is a key element of the human environment, and that it can support sustainable behavior.

technology plays four roles in understanding human conservation of natural resources, and that behavioral scientists can make a significant contribution to reducing the overall impact of technology on the environment by analyzing human behavior in concert with technology.

(1) technology can play a key role in understanding individuals' environmentally significant behavior; (2) technology can be used as intermediary, amplifier, determinant, and promoter of environmentally significant human behavior; (3) technology can be designed in such a way that it supports environmentally sustainable behavior; and (4) behavioral science research on the role of technology in conservation of natural resources is needed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding and influencing the role of technology in the conservation of natural and environmental resources.
the role of technology in human behavior, and with the behavioral aspects of technology, in particular with how technology can be designed to support resource conservation.
the role of technology in understanding individuals' resource conservation behavior and the potential for designing technology that supports resource conservation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
technology is a powerful tool to promote environmentally sustainable behavior.
technology is an essential element of a solution to the problem of resource depletion.
technology is a major factor in determining the extent of human impact on the environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
technology can be used in a positive manner to support the conservation of natural and human resources.
the conservation of resources is a complex and multifaceted problem, which calls for an interdisciplinary effort.
behavioral scientists should take the lead in developing and testing new ways to use technology for resource conservation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the behavioral sciences can contribute considerably to reduce overall environmental impact by studying human behavior in concert with technology.
behavioral scientists should take the lead in designing and implementing technology for resource conservation.
technology can be used to support and enhance resource conservation, and that this is an area in which behavioral science can make a major contribution.
